title: psoralea flexuosa
intro: Psoralea flexuosa, commonly known as Huang Qi, is a plant species that belongs to the legume family. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include improving digestion, reducing inflammation, and enhancing the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea flexuosa include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as isoflavones, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Psoralea flexuosa contribute to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
